name: Arnold of Brescia
biography: A saintly heretic who held that clergy owning property could not be saved, and supported the Roman popular movement for communal liberty against the Pope; burned by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa's forces, with his ashes thrown into the Tiber to prevent relic-veneration.
